findings.claim: The positive CVX case reports a resolved alternative even though it merely republishes the existing pointer span, so it proves no real filing repair.
findings.evidence: The case proposes Item 2's unchanged primary span as its alternative; verify_alternatives accepts the same pointer slice because it contains the Item 2 reference.
findings.repro: Run CVX extraction and route an Item 2 propose_alternative_regions action using that item's current start/end; routing reports resolved without distinct content.
findings.acceptance: Reject alternative evidence duplicating the target's current pointer span and make the real-filing positive case identify distinct normalized-text content that actually repairs the pointer.

findings.claim: A valid JSON completion of the wrong top-level type crashes the route instead of becoming an unparseable turn and bounded abstention.
findings.evidence: The route calls action.get before checking action is a dict; cached text [] raises AttributeError.
findings.repro: Stub llm.call to return cached text [] and invoke route with an internal_pointer_unreached warning.
findings.acceptance: Non-object or malformed responses are recorded unparseable, remain within the turn cap, preserve deterministic items, and leave unresolved targets review_required.

findings.claim: Agent tier envelopes report zero normalized-text characters even when a prior read_window observation sends text into the next call.
findings.evidence: Every turn hard-codes offset=0,input_chars=0 while read_window places up to 4,000 normalized-text characters in the next observation.
findings.repro: Replay read_window start=100,end=500 followed by finish and compare the second prompt with its tier range.
findings.acceptance: Each turn records the actual normalized-text range included in its prompt with correct truncation, and envelope validation rejects a mismatched range.

findings.claim: The invariant case does not bind mixed targets, search/read, exact next-prompt feedback, malformed responses, routing shape, or the API review_required surface.
findings.evidence: The current case uses one target/proposal actions, inspects an observation without asserting it enters the next prompt, skips _routing_shape, and calls build_view rather than the API projection.
findings.repro: Drop the observation before the next call or keep input_chars zero; the current d22-agent-loop case stays green.
findings.acceptance: Red-first end-to-end coverage binds multiple targets, search to read_window to proposal, exact next-call feedback, malformed responses, routing-envelope validation, and API payload review_required for every unresolved target.
